description: This Java source file defines the utility class `WebModuleUtil` for managing web modules within the OpenMRS platform. It handles module startup, shutdown, loading/unloading of servlets and filters, context refresh, and module-specific resource management.

classes.name: WebModuleUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for managing web modules, including startup, shutdown, servlet/filter registration, context refresh, and resource management within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: startModule
methods.description: Performs startup operations for a module, including copying resources, configuring web.xml, and optionally refreshing the Spring WebApplicationContext.

methods.name: stopTasks
methods.description: Stops all scheduled tasks associated with the given module.

methods.name: isModulePackageNameInTaskClass
methods.description: Checks if a task class belongs to the package of a specific module.

methods.name: notifySuperUsersAboutModuleFailure
methods.description: Sends alert notifications to super users if a module fails to start.

methods.name: loadServlets
methods.description: Loads and initializes servlets defined within a module.

methods.name: unloadServlets
methods.description: Removes and destroys servlets associated with a module.

methods.name: loadFilters
methods.description: Loads and initializes filters defined within a module and registers their mappings.

methods.name: unloadFilters
methods.description: Removes and destroys filters associated with a module.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns all filters registered by modules.

methods.name: getFilterMappings
methods.description: Returns all filter mappings registered by modules.

methods.name: getFiltersForRequest
methods.description: Retrieves applicable filters for a specific servlet request based on mappings.

methods.name: getDWRModuleXML
methods.description: Parses and returns the XML Document for dwr-modules.xml.

methods.name: shutdownModules
methods.description: Shuts down all loaded modules, unloads servlets, filters, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: stopModule
methods.description: Stops a specific module, removing servlets, filters, tasks, and updating related configuration files.

methods.name: refreshWAC
methods.description: Refreshes the Spring WebApplicationContext, including dispatchers, with optional startup parameters.

methods.name: setDispatcherServlet
methods.description: Stores the DispatcherServlet instance for later refresh and control.

methods.name: setStaticDispatcherServlet
methods.description: Stores the StaticDispatcherServlet instance for managing static content.

methods.name: getServlet
methods.description: Retrieves a loaded HttpServlet by its name.

methods.name: getModuleWebFolder
methods.description: Returns the file path to the web folder for a specific module.

methods.name: createDwrModulesXml
methods.description: Creates a blank dwr-modules.xml file in the specified real path.

methods.name: getRealPath
methods.description: Utility to get the real path of the servlet context.
